faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II position is 23 August 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Geography / Remote Sensing / Geoinformatics with a minimum of 2 years of research experience post M.Sc., or an M.Tech in Remote Sensing / Geoinformatics to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate - II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000 per month. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - II position at CSIR National Institute of Oceanography as per the latest notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - II recruitment is strictly online. Candidates are required to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate - II position is a contractual job. This means the appointment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR National Institute of Oceanography located?
faq.answer: CSIR National Institute of Oceanography is located in Goa. The recruitment is being conducted by this institute.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this job?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions for applications. Eligible candidates from all states can apply for this position as per the given criteria.
